name: universal-workbench
description: Coordinate research, engineering, design, and project context across available tools.

interface.longDescription: A skills-only plugin for routing multi-step work across available research, context, design, and engineering tools. It reuses tools already connected to your host.
defaultPrompt: Coordinate this task across my available tools and keep project context current.
Research this question with the right connected sources.
Implement this Figma design in my codebase.
